Global Vision Recruitment on Behalf of Loginet Technologies Pty Ltd

Date Posted: 13th July 2026

Position: ICT Project Manager (ANZSCO 135112)

Salary: $100,000 – $125,000 per annum plus Superannuation

Hours: 38 hours per week

Mode: Full-Time, Permanent

Location: 217 Margaret St, Toowoomba City QLD 4350

Experience required: Minimum three (3) years' experience managing ICT or software development projects

About Loginet Technologies

Loginet Technologies is an Australian technology consulting and digital transformation company committed to helping businesses leverage innovative technologies to improve efficiency, productivity, and sustainable growth. We deliver end-to-end ICT solutions across managed IT services, cloud computing, cybersecurity, software and mobile application development, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Generative AI, intelligent business automation, DevOps, enterprise networking, telecommunications, digital transformation, infrastructure management, ERP and CRM solutions, and managed technology support. Our experienced team works closely with organisations across diverse industries to design, implement, integrate, and support secure, scalable, and future-ready technology solutions that drive business innovation and operational excellence.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced ICT Project Manager to lead the successful planning, execution and delivery of complex ICT projects across software development, AI solutions, business automation, cloud services, cybersecurity and digital transformation initiatives.

Working closely with clients, business stakeholders and multidisciplinary technical teams, you will manage the complete project lifecycle, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget and to the highest quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

•	Manage the complete lifecycle of ICT projects from initiation through planning, execution, implementation and closure.

•	Lead software development, cloud migration, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Generative AI, intelligent automation and digital transformation projects.

•	Collaborate with clients to gather business requirements and translate them into successful project outcomes.

•	Develop project plans, budgets, schedules, milestones and resource allocation plans.

•	Coordinate cross-functional teams including software developers, AI engineers, cloud architects, infrastructure engineers, business analysts and cybersecurity specialists.

•	Manage Agile, Scrum and hybrid project delivery methodologies.

•	Monitor project progress, budgets, risks, issues and quality standards while ensuring successful project delivery.

•	Facilitate project workshops, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, stakeholder meetings and executive reporting.

•	Manage project governance, change requests, risk mitigation and quality assurance activities.

•	Coordinate with third-party vendors and technology partners to support successful project implementation.

•	Ensure successful deployment, client acceptance, knowledge transfer and operational handover following project completion.

•	Continuously improve project management processes and delivery frameworks across the organisation.

Essential Qualifications & Experience

•	Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems or a closely related ICT discipline.

•	Minimum three (3) years' experience managing ICT or software development projects.

•	Demonstrated experience delivering enterprise software, cloud, infrastructure or digital transformation projects.

•	Experience managing Agile and Scrum software development projects.

•	Strong stakeholder management and client engagement skills.

•	Excellent leadership, communication and organisational abilities.

•	Experience managing project budgets, schedules, risks and multidisciplinary project teams.

•	Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Desirable Skills

•	Experience delivering AI, Generative AI or intelligent automation projects.

•	Experience with workflow automation platforms including n8n, Microsoft Power Automate, Make.com or similar technologies.

•	Knowledge of AWS, Microsoft Azure or hybrid cloud environments.

•	Understanding of cybersecurity, enterprise networking and managed IT services.

•	Experience using Jira, Azure DevOps, Microsoft Project, ClickUp, Trello, Monday.com or similar project management platforms.

•	Project Management Professional (PMP), PRINCE2, Scrum Master or Agile certifications.

Why Join Loginet Technologies?

At Loginet Technologies, you will have the opportunity to work on innovative projects involving Artificial Intelligence, enterprise software development, intelligent automation, cloud computing, cybersecurity and digital transformation. We foster a collaborative and innovative workplace where employees are encouraged to develop their technical expertise, contribute to meaningful client outcomes and build long-term careers within a growing Australian technology company.

We offer:

•	Competitive remuneration package

•	Ongoing professional development and certification support

•	Flexible working arrangements

•	Exposure to enterprise cloud, AI and digital transformation projects

•	Career progression opportunities

•	Supportive and collaborative team culture

Interested applicant may submit their application to recruit@gvrc.com.au. Please note that only shortlisted candidate will be contacted.

If you’re hoping to find somewhere to spend your weekends leisurely exploring the range of beaches, or lying in a hammock enjoying the warm weather, then Broome might be the place for you.

We are now recruiting for a full-time Early Childhood Teacher to join our amazing team in Roebuck - Broome WA!

Broome is located in the North of Western Australia and promotes an easy going culture with a tropical climate. It's rich past history has created a wonderful community complementing the colourful natural fauna and pristine beaches it is known for.

Our centre has 5 beautiful and spacious rooms that allow us to split our age groups more effectively. Our newly-renovated yards allow children to play outdoors at all times - rain or shine. Head to our website www.mulberrytree.com.au and check out our beautiful centre.

Company benefits:

10% above award wage
95% discount on your childcare fees. (conditions apply)
Rent assistance.
Generous Staff Appreciation budgets at each centre to strengthen relationships and reward our teams, including decadent morning teas, dinners and much more.
CPR Courses organised and paid for by head office (course fees and time attended).
Support and availability of a WA based Senior Management Team.
Relationship centred environments.
3 hours a week of non-contact.
Paid professional development courses.
Uniform allocations (annual).
Flexible work life balance.
Opportunities to further develop your career.
Continual mentoring from experienced Colleagues.
Opportunity to travel (centres located in Perth).

Who you are:

We are looking for leaders who promote children's education through their interests and planned learning opportunities. You will foster children's curiosity and create opportunities for children to grow and explore in small groups. The ideal candidate will value the wonders of early learning within our upcycled learning environments and guide staff in providing a fun, safe, high-quality service that aligns with the National Quality Standards and is true to Mulberry Tree Childcare's fantastic reputation. We embrace our children's love for learning and want you to concentrate on developing each child's trust and sense of security.

Criteria:

Bachelor of Early Childhood / Grad Diploma of Education (Early Childhood) / Bachelor in Education (Early Childhood) or ACECQA equivalent approved qualification OR be working towards your ECT qualification (50% of units finished).
Current Asthma, Anaphylaxis, CPR & First Aid certificates or willingness to obtain.
Current WWCC or willingness to obtain.
Knowledge and understanding of the Early Years Learning Framework / National Quality Framework / National Quality Standards / Belonging, Being and Becoming.
Understanding of Childcare Regulations and Law.

Ideal Candidate:

A strong level of communication skills and the ability to build strong relationships with staff, children, families and the community.
Be an inspiring leader and positive role model.
Have personal and professional aspirations to make the childcare industry that of a high professional standard.
Have a readiness to go above and beyond for the children and families.
Have a passion to make a difference in every child's learning Journey.
Be flexible, reliable and overall have a happy persona.
Want to make a difference in every child's life.

Who we are:

Mulberry Tree Childcare are a WA privately owned and operated family business that has supported WA children and families for 30 years. Our Mulberry Tree teams pride themselves in knowing that "Every moment in a child's life is a learning opportunity". Mulberry Tree are continually investing in their staff and centres and ensuring they are the best they can be.

To Apply:

Ready for an exciting change and to be part of an amazing team?

Apply today, by forwarding your resume to start your new venture!

Look forward to hearing from you.

Irrigation Technician
Employer:Rita's Farm Produce Pty Limited
Location: 1204 Mamre Road, Kemps Creek, NSW 2178, Australia
Employment type: Full-time, 38 hours per week
Remuneration: $75,000 - $85,000 

About Rita Farm
Since its establishment in 2001, Rita's Farm Produce Pty Limited has been deeply engaged in Australia's organic agriculture sector for over 20 years. It is a highly reputable certified organic family farm in New South Wales, located at 1204 Mamre Road, Kemps Creek, covering an area of 55 acres. Adhering to strict organic farming standards, the farm consistently upholds the core philosophy of "growing food as medicine" and is committed to providing high-quality organic fruits, vegetables, and baked goods—free of chemical pesticides and synthetic fertilizers—to Sydney, Canberra, and surrounding regions.
We adhere to sustainable agricultural practices and protect biodiversity through ecological balance technologies, having now become a benchmark brand in the local organic agriculture sector. To support the farm's large-scale development and the refined management of its irrigation systems, we are sincerely inviting professional irrigation technicians to join us in jointly safeguarding the core lifeline of organic farming.

Duties & Responsibilities
System Operation & Maintenance Management: Responsible for the daily operation, inspection, maintenance, and troubleshooting of drip/sprinkler irrigation systems (including water pumps, pipelines, etc.), ensuring the precise irrigation needs of 55 acres of organic crops are met.
Irrigation Plan Development: Develop scientific irrigation plans based on organic standards, crop cycles, soil, and climate data. Precisely control water volume and frequency to ensure certification compliance.
Fertigation Integration Operation: Operate relevant equipment to precisely mix organic fertilizers for simultaneous irrigation. Monitor the process and record data to ensure efficient nutrient absorption.
Data Optimization & Review: Establish operation records for irrigation systems, documenting equipment status, test data, etc. Regularly analyze efficiency and propose optimization or upgrade suggestions.
Safety & Collaboration Assurance: Adhere to WHS (Work Health and Safety) standards. Coordinate with the planting team and farm manager to provide irrigation technical support and participate in planting planning meetings.

Selection Criteria / Skills & Qualifications
Possess 1-3 years of relevant experience in irrigation system installation/maintenance, or practical experience in horticultural/agricultural irrigation.
Proficient in the operation and maintenance of core irrigation system components, including pumps, valves, piping, and irrigation controllers, with a solid understanding of water supply scheduling logic.
Have a basic grasp of the principles of hydraulic parameters in agricultural/horticultural settings and an understanding of water resource optimization and management methods.
Adaptable to outdoor working environments, capable of independently completing physical work tasks, and equipped with reliable maintenance execution capabilities.
Demonstrate strong communication and coordination skills, able to effectively collaborate with farm teams and management.
Meticulous and reliable in work, prioritize work safety, strictly comply with labour hire industry standards, and adhere to high-quality craftsmanship requirements.
Flexible to adjust work arrangements in line with the farm’s production cycles.

What We Offer
Competitive salary for a full-time, 38-hour week role.
Stable employment with compliant labour-hire arrangements, including rostered hours, structured workforce management, and professional work conditions aligned with our values of integrity, reliability, and compliance.

More information
For more information, please email(adding company email). To learn more about working with us, we encourage you to visit our website
https://www.ritasfarm.com.au/

1204 Mamre Road, Kemps Creek, NSW 2178, Australia

Visa sponsorship

About the role:

We are currently seeking motivated and reliable individuals who can work as a Harvest Picker, Production Line Worker and Irrigation Farm Hand to work at our farm in Nericon, NSW. These roles are essential to the continued success of our farm operations and provide a great opportunity to work in a dynamic, outdoor environment.

You will work on a casual basis at Nericon, NSW. 

Job Descriptions: 

As an IRRIGATION FARM HAND, you will ensure the irrigation system is working at all times to ensure the crops are receiving sufficient water.  

About the role:

•	Turns irrigation systems on and off as designated
•	Operate a RTV/Mule.
•	Replaces or repairs irrigation valves.
•	Commissioning of blocks.
•	Regular pressure checks and fixing of leaks on blocks/mainlines.
•	Installs or repairs of irrigation lines.
•	Ensures proper care in the use and maintenance of equipment and supplies.
•	Performs miscellaneous job-related duties as assigned.
•	Performing general labouring duties, such as landscaping, spraying (Knapsack) upkeep of pump sheds.
•	Perform basic recording functions such as pesticide use and water levels.
•	Provide assistance within the scope of this level to other employees as required.
•	Perform daily pre-start checks.
•	Clear and maintain irrigation ditches, as directed by supervisor.
•	Assisting with minor repairs and maintenance of vehicles, assets, and equipment.
•	Promotes continuous improvement of workplace safety and environmental practices.
•	Participating in training programs to enhance skills and knowledge related to horticultural practices and safety procedures. 


As a PRODUCTION LINE WORKER, you will assist in all-round stock controlling, picking, packing and quality assurance of produce.

About the role:
• Receiving incoming goods, checking for damage and for discrepancies between goods and packing orders.
• Unloading vehicles, opening packages, and removing contents.
• Labelling goods with details of storage location.
• Packing and weighing goods and sealing boxes.
• Assisting with regular stocktakes.


As a HARVEST PICKER, your role will include, but are not limited to:

• Picking fruit and vegetables according to size and ripeness by hand
• Discarding rotting and over-ripened produce following our quality standards
• Operating small tractors, when required
• Loading picked fresh produce into containers
• Digging and planting/transplanting seedlings by hand


To be successful in the role you will possess the following:

•	Willingness to work in various weather conditions.
•	Physical fitness and ability to perform manual labour.
•	Basic mechanical aptitude for equipment operation and maintenance.
•	Strong work ethic, reliability, and punctuality.
•	Ability to follow instructions and work as part of a team.
•	Eagerness to learn and adapt to farm-specific procedures and practices.
•	Team player who can work effectively with people from different backgrounds.
•	Awareness and ability to adhere to WHS requirements.
•	Flexibility in hours worked to achieve operational targets, including weekends, overtime and public holidays.


In return we offer you:

•	A collaborative and supportive team environment.
•	Training and development opportunities.

Number of positions available: 6
Hours per week: 30 hours per week
Commencement date: 1st October 2026 to June 2027 (9 months)
Renumeration: Starting at Level 1 $32.01/hour. If you have previous experience or after 3 months of experience on the farm, you will progress to Level 2 $33.05/hour (Horticultural Award 2020).


For more information, please email hr@rombolafamilyfarms.com.au. To learn more about working with us, we encourage you to visit our website http://www.rombolafamilyfarms.com.au
